offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and markets plasma-derived immune globulin products for immune-deficient and at-risk patients. It collects source plasma through its own centers and manufactures products at its Boca Raton facility. It sells mainly to distributors and treatment centers.

primary_products.value: intravenous immune globulin; hyperimmune globulin; source plasma; specialty immune globulins

primary_services.value: contract plasma fractionation and testing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty distributors, physician offices, infusion centers, hospitals, and other plasma and biologics companies

end_markets.value: healthcare; primary immunodeficiency treatment; infectious disease prevention; biopharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: immune globulin products and source plasma sold to distributors and providers; service fees: contract manufacturing and testing for third parties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: collects plasma and fractionates it into immune globulins, sold to distributors and providers; asset operator: operates plasma collection centers supplying source plasma

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily the United States, with some international sales

specialization.value: related lines: plasma collection, immune globulin manufacturing, and related products and services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty distributors supplying infusion centers and physicians; direct sales: sales to hospitals, treatment centers and biopharma customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: biologics need FDA licensure and approval, plasma centers are regulated by FDA cGMP rules
